about: The falsifier: a count no fold reads. host/stores.ts counts the leaves of a store laid inside a place, but no reading of the instrument folded it. So the owner's ceiling audit/tree/no-store-inside-a-place could not be signed: accept refuses a ceiling no reading meets as INERT, and 402 leaves under bound/.bound went unread.

cases.name: bound/.bound, laid when bound/ was folded as a root
